items.title: As Wardogs Season 3 looms, Bulkhead claims to have built 'one of the world's most sophisticated anti-cheat systems', assisted by 'machine learning and AI'
items.excerpt: Bulkhead says Wardogs' new anti-cheat was built by analysing 187 million hours of gameplay with machine learning and AI; it arrives with Season 3 on November 12 alongside a new urban map.
items.keyword: AI bug detection games / AI anti-cheat

items.title: The AI posting war is heating up: 'Please, leave me behind,' says artist who got into it with Epic CEO Tim Sweeney on X
items.excerpt: Asset artist Kenney urged artists not to cave to pressure to use generative AI; Epic CEO Tim Sweeney replied 'This is bullshit, Kenney', and the clash split developers and players on X.

items.title: Nvidia announces 3 more DLSS 5 games
items.excerpt: DLSS 5's 3D-guided neural rendering, which uses generative AI to add lighting and materials that developers tune, ships this month in Hogwarts Legacy, War Thunder (mid-November) and Where Winds Meet (Nov 23). Note: War Thunder DLSS 5 was published 11-04, so this is a follow-up.

items.title: New AI-Assisted Retopology Software Launches For PC
items.excerpt: Sparseal launched CozyBlanket Pro for Windows and macOS. Its AI analyses high- and low-poly meshes in real time and suggests topology fixes: quad-filling, edge-loop rerouting and pole placement. It also does UV unwrapping and baking.

items.title: Official Unity plugin for OpenAI's Codex
items.excerpt: Unity launched an official Unity plugin for OpenAI's Codex in OpenAI's plugin directory. Once installed, Codex can pick any skill in the plugin to complete Unity tasks; the video walks through four scenarios. A sibling of the Antigravity plugin published 11-03.

items.title: 캐릭터와 스토리 만들어 공유, AI 플랫폼 디어비 출시
items.excerpt: 디어비가 AI 컴패니언·AI UGC 플랫폼 '디어비(Dearbe)'를 구글 플레이와 웹으로 정식 출시했다. 이용자는 AI 캐릭터와 대화하고, 직접 캐릭터·스토리·세계관을 만들어 공유하며, 피규어 만들기·OST 제작·미니게임도 즐길 수 있다.

items.title: 94% of Game Studios Use AI But Rate Their Integration 3/10, And That Gap Is Why "Made With AI" Labels Are Already Meaningless
items.excerpt: Vivrato's VAIA Report interviewed 101 senior studio leaders: 94% use AI in some form, but the median self-rating of how deeply it is embedded is 3/10. Adam Boyes argued at GamesBeat Next that the industry is measuring the wrong thing.

items.title: The game reverse engineering community is the latest casualty of AI
items.excerpt: decomp.dev is sunsetting. Its admin says AI-driven 'drive-by' forks and AI-crafted ports broke the community side of game decompilation, and that the site's leaderboards had gamified the work. Off-list exception; the decomp.dev shutdown itself dates to mid-October, so this is a late recap.
items.keyword: AI mod UGC / vibe coding games

items.title: Ubisoft scales AI coding agents to 4,000+ developers with Unity Gateway
items.excerpt: Databricks customer story: Ubisoft rolled out AI coding agents to more than 4,000 developers through Unity Gateway (Databricks' AI gateway), with centralised model access, governance and usage tracking. Off-list exception: a concrete studio deployment. Vendor case study, so verify the figures.
items.keyword: AI game design tool / engine coding agent

items.title: 신작 연기 반복한 넷마블, 내년 13종 출시 자신…AI로 개발 속도 높인다
items.excerpt: 넷마블이 내년 신작 13종 출시를 AI 기반 개발·운영 체계로 뒷받침한다. 기획부터 번역·녹음·그래픽 제작, 품질 검증·운영 자동화까지 반복 업무에 AI를 쓴다. 매체 목록 밖이지만, 스튜디오가 실제로 AI를 배치한 사례라 예외로 넣었다.

items.title: [기획 | 게임사 AI 전환의 현주소 ④]… 크래프톤, 결과보다 AI 협업 과정 평가
items.excerpt: 크래프톤은 2027 채용연계형 인턴십 6개 직군의 AI 역량평가에 자체 개발한 '코파 프로브(Cofa-Probe)'를 쓴다. 지원자가 업무 에이전트와 협업하는 과정을 소스코드·프롬프트·검증 기록까지 자동 수집해 기술·의도·인지 관리 세 축으로 평가한다.

items.title: Claude updates its policy and allows naming games to prototype mechanics
items.excerpt: Foro3D reports that Anthropic revised Claude's no-recreating-games rule: in prompt version 2.1.317 the model lets users name a game to describe its mechanics and offers an original take in that genre instead. Single off-list source, unverified; the same story as the 11-02 Claude clone rule unless an on-list outlet confirms it.

items.title: Gala Games Points Creators To Playworks, Its AI Browser Game Builder, In Fresh X Post
items.excerpt: Gala Games sent users to Gala Playworks, an AI tool that turns a written game description into a playable browser game. Off-list crypto-gaming outlet. This is a promo post, not a new launch, so it's a weak pick.

items.title: "당연히 '카트라이더'인 줄 알았는데…" 게임 AI 복제에 대기업도 '발칵', 무슨 일
items.excerpt: AI 기반 게임 복제 우려가 대형 게임사까지 번졌다. 로블록스에 넥슨 '카트라이더'와 밸브 게임 등을 베낀 AI 제작 게임이 올라와 문제가 됐다. 매체 목록 밖이며, 이번 주 크게 다뤄진 AI 클론 이야기와 겹친다.

items.title: Overwolf's Nitro & Base44 Launch $65K Contest for Web Games Built with AI
items.excerpt: Overwolf's Nitro and the AI app builder Base44 launched a $65K contest for web games built with AI. Off-list. Low priority: a contest, not a tool release.
